The '''Juggernaut''' is a naval unit introduced in the [[Path of the Ocean Beta]]. 

When a [[Giant]] moves into a [[port]], it becomes a Juggernaut. Like [[Rammer|Rammers]], these ships do not have a ranged attack. Instead, they have a unique [[Unit Skills|skill]] called Stomp, which damages all enemies adjacent to the juggernaut anytime it moves. 

When a Giant moves onto a port or when the Juggernaut disembarks, it also does stomp damage.

== Trivia ==

* [[File:Juggernaut alpha.png|thumb|A Sha-po Juggernaut from before Path of the Ocean.]]In an early developmental stage prior to the [[Path of the Ocean]] beta, Juggernauts were intended for transport and could not attack.<ref>{{Cite social media|author=Zoythrus|website=Discord|date=12 October 2023|link=https://discord.com/channels/283436219780825088/561211722296197120/1162058534544998430}}</ref> This was reflected in their appearance as a Giant sitting on a raft.<ref>{{Cite social media|author=Zoythrus|website=Discord|date=12 October 2023|link=https://discord.com/channels/283436219780825088/561211722296197120/1162160310669545526}}</ref>
*[[File:Juggernaut old.png|thumb|A Juggernaut from the Path of the Ocean Beta]]In the Path of the Ocean beta, Juggernauts had 2 movement, 3 attack, 3 defense, and 3 range but lacked the ''stiff'' skill. Their appearance included a cannon to reflect their ranged nature.
*[[File:Juggernaut beta.png|thumb|A Bardur Juggernaut from beta 2.8.0.11434]]In beta update 2.8.0.11434, Juggernauts were given their current stats. They had a different appearance, and their "Stomp" skill was then named "Smash."
